name: Hitman: Contracts
description: Hitman: Contracts is a singleplayer third-person stealth game and the third in the Hitman series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Hitman: Contracts' configuration.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound buffers
optional_settings.reason: Hitman: Contracts can play more sounds at once with 128 sound buffers.

optional_settings.title: Raise graphics quality
optional_settings.reason: Automatically sets Hitman: Contracts' draw distance, level of detail, shadow detail, post-filter detail, bump mapping and weather effects at their highest settings.
